suggested_change: Add to CLAUDE.md: 'When carry-forwarding scores between calls, explicitly document whether new evidence justifies a change or if score remains stable. Score increases require citation of novel information from the current call. Next steps must use direct imperatives (e.g., "Request that X build Y") rather than questions or conditional phrasing (e.g., "Would you be willing to..."). Quantifiable asks must include specific metrics targets (e.g., "A/B tests per month") rather than open-ended questions.'
